name: Layering Reading, Writing and Thinking
description: This microcredential recognizes your reflection on how layering reading, writing, and discussion supports students in developing claims across multiple texts.
criteria:
To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

* A comparison of the Layering Reading, Writing, and Discussion process with how you have previously taught multi-text reading or argument writing.

* Specific insights about what feels familiar, what feels new, and how this approach might shift or refine your instruction moving forward.

* A clear description of the role of talk and discussion in your classroom, including both the opportunities you currently provide and any challenges you encounter.

Home

Layering Reading, Writing and Thinking

Micro-Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This microcredential recognizes your reflection on how layering reading, writing, and discussion supports students in developing claims across multiple texts.

Criteria

To earn the microcredential for this module, be sure your reflection includes:

  • A comparison of the Layering Reading, Writing, and Discussion process with how you have previously taught multi-text reading or argument writing.

  • Specific insights about what feels familiar, what feels new, and how this approach might shift or refine your instruction moving forward.

  • A clear description of the role of talk and discussion in your classroom, including both the opportunities you currently provide and any challenges you encounter.
